title: POV: SLEDDING PAST
A SNOWMAN WHO WANTS A TAN
caption: Bouncy tropical house at 126 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, marimba and steel drum plucks, sleigh bells, warm sub bass, airy synth pads, cheerful cheeky female pop vocal, very catchy chant-like chorus, winter-holiday party energy, clean modern mix
lyrics:
[Intro - house beat]

[Verse 1]
Snowman on a sunbed wants a summer tan
Penguin on a skateboard, catch me if you can
Icicles are ringing like a xylophone
Yeti in a bathrobe talking on the phone

[Chorus]
Slide, slide, down the frozen hill
Hot cocoa river giving me a chill
Spin around and touch the sky
Snowman waves and says goodbye

[Verse 2]
Reindeer on a jet ski doing it in style
Polar bear is knitting with a cheesy smile
Marshmallow avalanche falling on my head
Wake me up in summer, I'm going back to bed

[Chorus]
Slide, slide, down the frozen hill
Hot cocoa river giving me a chill
Spin around and touch the sky
Snowman waves and says goodbye

[Outro - instrumental]
